config.heading: Before you book
config.subtitle: Plain answers to what patients ask us first.

items.question: Who can be considered for a prescription?
items.answer: Eligibility is decided by a clinician, case by case. As a starting point you will usually need a diagnosed condition and to have tried other licensed treatments first. The eligibility check tells you whether a consultation is the right next step.

items.question: Do I need a referral from my own doctor?
items.answer: No referral is needed to start the eligibility check. Your clinician may ask for a summary of your medical records before the consultation.

items.question: What happens in the consultation?
items.answer: You speak with a registered specialist by video. They review your history and current medicines, answer your questions, and decide with you whether a prescription is appropriate.

items.question: How is my prescription delivered?
items.answer: Our pharmacy sends it in plain, tracked packaging. A signature is needed when it arrives.

items.question: Can I order without a prescription?
items.answer: No. You can browse the range, but items can only be ordered against a valid prescription held on your account.

config.heading: Find out whether a consultation is right for you.
config.subtitle: The eligibility check takes a few minutes, and there is no obligation to book.
